prompts.name: cafe
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent game sprite / parallax layer extracted from the supplied illustration.
Extract ONLY the central beige cafe building with muted red hipped roofs, small black emblem, dark gray terrace canopy, enclosed dark terrace, support posts and all its small planters. Preserve its recognizable design, original subdued beige and dusty red colors, flat geometric vector cartoon drawing style, architecture and perspective extremely closely. Remove the large cream gabled house behind it, EVERY other building, sky, clouds, street lamps, hedges beyond the cafe, pavement and road. No additions.
Deliver this cafe COMPLETELY ISOLATED ON GENUINELY TRANSPARENT RGBA background (alpha zero outside silhouette, not a checkerboard drawing, not white, not gray). Reconstruct any small hidden parts logically. Include the whole cafe silhouette, roof tips and terrace bottom. Transparent holes between terrace posts where appropriate but keep enclosed cafe interiors dark. No ground shadow or ground plane.
Frame: tight landscape sprite canvas with approx 4 percent transparent padding around the cafe, centered. Do NOT include empty full-width landscape scene. Straight level baseline. Keep the same visual styling and colors; do not redesign, overdetail or photorealize.

prompts.name: house
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: isolated transparent game sprite for parallax.
Extract ONLY the tall cream-colored house directly behind and to the right of the cafe in the supplied illustration. It has a tall triangular gable at its left front, a long muted terracotta pitched roof sloping to the right, two dark rectangular chimneys, a small circular attic vent, cream facade with evenly spaced narrow rectangular windows, and a low arched doorway. Remove the cafe and reconstruct the ENTIRE lower and left parts of this house that the cafe previously occluded, as a plausible continuous two-story cream building down to a straight baseline. Preserve the roof silhouette, perspective, subdued original colors and simple flat vector-style geometric cartoon design of this exact house. Show only shallow 3/4 perspective as in the reference.
Transparent RGBA background, alpha zero outside house. No sky, cloud, other buildings, trees, hedges, planters, road, pavement, ground shadow, UI or text. No checkerboard drawn into image. No gradients or textures. Fully visible whole roof, chimney tops, walls and base; no cropping. Isolated house fills a landscape canvas with 6% transparent padding all around. Maintain a tall triangular front at left and a longer side facade extending to right. Do not redesign as a generic house.

prompts.name: near-street
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: one isolated panoramic near-town parallax strip for a 2D endless runner.
Use the supplied panorama as the exact style and street architecture reference. Create the surrounding street buildings visible to the far left and far right, extended into one continuous full-width row of buildings. REMOVE the central beige cafe and the tall cream/red-roof house behind it entirely; replace their locations with modest low two-story urban shop facades so that this layer has no gap when the cafe and house move independently in front. No cafe logo anywhere. Keep central replacement roofs fairly low. Retain recognizable varied block buildings at left, small pitched roof shops, modest urban windows, with a few simple gray trees and hedges. No street lamps (they will be a separate layer).
COLOR: grayscale palette only. Base near skyline and facade color #50575a; secondary plane #454b4d; roofs darker slate gray #454b4d. Windows pale gray rgba(210,213,210,0.32) composited onto facade. No red roofs, no beige, no colorful facades. Large flat solid color shapes; exact simple geometric vector cartoon game look, not textured, not photorealistic, not painterly, no gradients.
Composition: ultra-wide 3:1 landscape canvas. Straight side-on row of buildings spans edge to edge across full width, all bases aligned to a single horizontal line approx 90% down the image. Tallest buildings reach approx 12% down the canvas, low central facades approx 45% down. Simple shallow perspective only. Small flat roof building at both extreme edges, SAME facade color and same roof height at left and right edges to allow repeating this strip seamlessly horizontally. No margins left/right.
Everything above the architecture silhouette and below its straight baseline must be GENUINELY TRANSPARENT, alpha zero. No sky or clouds, no sun, no distant skyline, no road, no sidewalk, no ground shadow or floor, no people/vehicles, no UI or text. RGBA transparent background, no fake checkerboard, no gray background plate.
